aria-hidden only hides content from assistive tech, not visually — it must still be rendered

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>visible</p><div aria-hidden="true">still shown</div><p>also visible</p>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone()));
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
